answer_1.quote: Given a manipulated image and its source, a model must generate natural language answers to a set of open-ended questions.
answer_1.outputs: natural language answers and rationales for open-ended questions about image edits

answer_2.quote: We calculate generative metrics (e.g. METEOR) by appending the rationale to the response.

answer_4.quote: We provide two human evaluation metrics -head-to-head, in which generated responses are compared to human responses, and accuracy, in which humans are asked to label if generated responses are accurate in regards to the given edit.
answer_4.guideline: Humans are asked to label if generated responses are accurate in regards to the given edit.
